name: SoulJah Kingdom Rise
detailed_description:
Souljah Kingdom Rise is a narrative focused 3rd person cover shooter with emphasis on player progression and customisation

There are two distinct gameplay loops; explorable sandbox areas, as well as more linear missions, similar to a traditional campaign experience.

Souljah Kingdom Rise will offer the player in-depth customisation choices, not only in gameplay, but also with it's accessibility. 

Souljah Kingdom Rise is based in the heart of Jamaica set in the year 2060.

The setting is a unique feature about our project as well as its heritage and traditions which will all be present within the environment. We will be using prominent folklore stories from Jamaica which is embedded within the very foundation of the progression system.

This will be the first look at the franchise which will be further developed.

Key Features:

  • Explorable gameplay space with secrets to find.

  • 3rd Person Shooter gameplay in a vibrant tropical yet modern environment.

  • Detailed progression system based on Jamaican and African folklore. 

  • Minimal immersive UI.

  • Achievements to earn.

short_description: SoulJah Kingdom Rise is the first look at an upcoming 3rd Person shooter Action-Adventure franchise. Set in Jamaica in the year 2060, play as Akan and experience the first look at the world of SKR. Complete objectives in the Jamaican Defence Force, uncover secrets and clean the streets.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 2080 8GB or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • VR Support: None

content_descriptors.notes: This game features mature content that portrays blood and bodily injury, as well as inciting violence in the main objective of the game. We do not incentivise violent acts against innocent NPCs in the experience.
